explanation: The value is 0 at every GO and D2 step and almost always 0 at D1 during rewarded streaks. At D1 it rises as a run of unrewarded trials piles up while the agent has been choosing a1: about 0-3 after one loss, about 5-6 after two in a row, and 10 on the D1 of the trial where the agent switches to a2 (it stays near 10 while a2 trials keep failing via rare S1). It falls back to 0 on the D1 right after the first reward reached through S2, though an occasional reward right after a1 losses can still give 4-8.
